we proclaim jesus christ as lord” (2 cor 4:5). united in mission jesus prayed that his disciples might be one, so th at the world might believe. our unity itself becomes a witness to the gospel. when people see christians loving, forgiving and supporting one another, they can experience som ething of god’s love. mission belongs to every baptized person. we may not travel to distant countries, but we can be missionaries wherever we are: in our homes, parish, workplaces and communities. mission to love pope leo reminds us that love is at the heart of mission. saint francis of assisi said, “love is not loved.” saint thérèse also desired “to love jesus and to makehim loved.” on this world mission day, may we renew our missionary spiri t. through our prayer, kindness, generosity and care for those in need, may we make jesus known and loved. may christ make us one in him, unite us in mission, and send us out to share god’s love with everyone. ennis

mission sunday this year we celebrate 100th world mission day, a celebration begun by pope pius xi one hundred years ago. pope leo xiv has chosen the beautiful theme “ one in christ, united in mission” . he invites us to “ renew in ourselves the fire of our missionary vocation” . today in every catholic church in the world, a second collection will take place to support the work of missionaries. please be generous to this appeal. —————————————-- blessing of new life & expectant parents in ss peter & paul church , clarecastle on tuesday october 20th at 7pm for the abbey pastoral area. all welcome. ——————————————— adult faith formation invite you to an autumn gathering “let’s have an honest conversation about synodality ”. adialogue among clergy and laity on how we can journey together as church. facilitated by fr. eamon fitzgibbonon saturday next 24th october from 10am to 1pm in the parish centre station rd., ennis. eire óg on this sunday we extend our good wishes to éire óg as they take on kilmurray ibrickane in the county football final. cathedral renovation appeal in the past week fr. tom wishes to acknowledge donations of €500 & €300. we thank the many people who have made once off contributions to this appeal. ennis national school knitting club would like to extend a heartfelt thank you to everyone who generously donated wool and knitting needles to our school knitting club. thanks to your kindness, children from 3rd to 6th class can learn a valuable lifelong skill, develop their creativity and enjoy the satisfaction of making something with their own hands. our free knitting club brings children toget her and helps keep a wonderful traditional skill alive. every donation is truly valued and appreciated. clare macra– new members welcome! are you aged 17–40 and interested in meeting new people, making friends and getting involved in your local community? clare macra offers a wide range of social activities, nights out, sports, competitions , training and travel opportunities. you don't need a farming background to join – macra welcomes young people from all walks of life! there are three clubs in county clare: ennis, sixmilebridge/ kilmurry and west clare. follow @claremacra on instagram to find out more! lost engagement ring lost in ennis on friday 9th october. huge sentimental value. contact david

prayer for the healing of nations lord jesus, we beseech you to unite the people of the earth in your love. break down walls of division, prejudice, and misunderstanding. inspire nations to act with fairness, generosity, and integrity. may your spirit teach us to see one another as brothers and sisters, valuing each life as precious. guide diplomats, leaders, and citizens to embrace dialogue and seek solutions rooted in justice and mercy teach us to forgive, reconcile, and serve one another with humility.

today’s script ure readings entrance antiphon to you i call; for you will surely heed me, o god; turn your ear to me; hear my words. guard me as the apple of your eye; in the shadow of your wings protect me. penitential rite p. have mercy on us, o lord c. for we have sinned against you. p. show us, o lord, your mercy. c. and grant us your salvation. p. may almighty god have mercy on us, forgive us our sins, and bring us to everlasting life. c. amen. gloria glory to god in the highest, and on earth peace to people of good will. we praise you, we bless you, we adore you, we glorify you, we give you thanks for your great glory, lord god, heavenly king, god, almighty father. lord jesus christ, only begotten son, lord god, lamb of god, son of the father, you take away the sins of the world, have mercy on us; you take away the sins of the world, receive our prayer; you are seated at the right hand of the father, have mercy on us. for you alone are the holy one, you alone are the lord, you alone are the most high, jesus christ, with the holy spirit, in the glory of god the father. amen. a reading from the prophet isaiah. is 45:1.4-6 thus says the lord to his anointed, to cyrus, whom he has taken by his right hand to subdue nations before him and strip the loins of kings, to force gateways before him that their gates be closed no more: it is for the sake of my servant jacob, of israel my chosen one, that i have called you by your name, conferring a title though you do not know me. i am the lord, unrivalled; there is no other god besides me. though you do not know me, i arm you that men may know from the rising to the setting of the sun that, apart from me, all is nothing. the word of the lord responsorial psalm r: give the lord glory and power. osing a new song to the lord, sing to the lord all the earth. tell among the nations his glory and his wonders among all the peoples. r. the lord is great and worthy of praise, to be feared above all gods; the gods of the heathens are naught. it was the lord who made the heavens. r. give the lord, you families of peoples, give the lord glory and power, give the lord the glory of his name. bring an offering and enter his courts. r. worship the lord in his temple. oearth, tremble before him. proclaim to the natio ns:‘god is king.’ he will judge the peoples in fairness. r. a reading from the first letter of st. paul to the thessalonians. 1th 1:1-5 from paul, silvanus and timothy, to the church in thessalonika which is in god the father and the lord jesus christ; wishing you grace and peace from god the father and the lord jesus christ. we always mention you in our prayers and thank god for you all, and constantly remember before god our father how you have shown your faith in action, worked for love and persevered through hope, in our lord jesus christ we know, brothers, that god loves you and that you have been chosen, because when we brought the good news to you, it came to you not only as words, but as power and as the holy spirit and as utter conviction. the word of the lord gospel acclamation alleluia, alleluia! you will shine in the world like bright stars because you are offering it the word of life. alleluia a reading from the holy gospel according to matthew. mt 22:15-21 the pharisees went away to work out between them how to trap jesus in what he said. and they sent their disciples to him, together with the herodians, to say, 'master, we know that you are an honest man and teach the way of god in an hon- estway, and that you are not afraid of any-one, because a man’s rank means nothing to you. tell us your opinion, then. is it per- missible to pay taxes to caesar or not?' but jesus was aware of their malice and re- plied, 'you hypocrites! why do you set this trap for me? let me see the money you pay the tax with.' they handed him a de- narius, and he said, 'whose head is this? whose name?' 'caesar's' they replied. he then said to them, 'very well, give back to caesar what belongs to caesar - and to god what belongs to god.' the gospel of the lord profession of faith i believe in one god, the father almighty, maker of heaven and earth, of all things visible and invisible. i believe in one lord jesus christ, the only begotten son of god, born of the father before all ages. god from god, light from light, true god from true god, begotten, not made, consubstantial with the father; through him all things were made. for us men and for our salvation he came down from heaven, and by the holy spirit was incarnate of the virgin mary, and became man. for our sake he was crucified under pontius pilate, he suf- fered death and was buried, and rose again on the third day in accordance with the scriptures. he ascended into heaven and is seated at the right hand of the father. he will come again in glory to judge the living and the dead and his kingdom will have no end. i believe in the holy spirit, the lord, the giver of life, who proceeds from the father and the son, who with the father and the son is adored and glorified, who has spo-ken through the prophets. i believe in one, holy, catholic and apostolic church. i confess one baptism for the for- giveness of sins and i look forward to the resurrection of the dead and the life of the world to come. amen. communion antiphon behold, the eyes of the lord are on those who fear him, who hope in his merciful love to rescue their souls from death, to keep them alive in famine.
